items.title: NFL and AWS Introduce Next Gen Trends
items.summary: A first-of-its-kind interactive platform, Next Gen Trends is free to all fans, and goes beyond the box score to show the strategic identity of every team and the trends reshaping the league. Every NFL team has a fingerprint, a play style all its own, and it shows up on every single snap. Watch a team […]
